title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 49. Calls for a significant increase in common procurement by the Member States of required European defence equipment and capabilities; calls on the Member States to aggregate demand by procuring defence equipment jointly, making better use of the existing mechanisms provided by the European Defence Agency and the Organisation for Joint Armament Cooperation, ideally ensuring a long-term planning horizon for the EDTIB, thus improving the EDTIB’s production capacities and the interoperability of the European armed forces, and making efficient use of taxpayers’ money through economies of scale;
